hero.lead: Brightarc backs startups and small businesses with growth capital, shareholder liquidity, and hands-on leadership and strategy consulting. One partner for the money and the thinking behind it.

visual.label: Two ways up
visual.caption: Growth capital, shareholder liquidity and leadership consulting, separately or together.

services.title: In plain terms, we help in three ways.
services.intro: No jargon, no layers. Here is what Brightarc offers and when each one makes sense.

items.title: Growth capital
items.text: Funding for the next stage of the business, whether that means hiring, a new location, product development or working capital.
items.fit: You have momentum and a clear plan for what the capital will do.

items.title: Shareholder liquidity
items.text: A way for founders, partners or early shareholders to turn part or all of their ownership into cash, while the business keeps moving.
items.fit: A shareholder wants out, or you want to take some risk off the table.

items.title: Leadership and strategy consulting
items.text: An experienced outside view on the decisions that shape the company: priorities, structure, growth plans and the leadership needed to deliver them.
items.fit: The business has outgrown the way it is run.

approach.title: Two arcs, one horizon.
approach.intro: Look at our mark: two arcs rising together. Capital on its own rarely fixes a strategy problem, and a good plan stalls without the means to carry it out. We offer both, side by side.

panels.label: Leadership and strategy
panels.title: The thinking
panels.text: Clear priorities, sound structure and the leadership habits that let a company grow without losing its footing.

panels.label: Capital
panels.title: The fuel
panels.text: Growth capital or shareholder liquidity, structured around the business and the people who own it.

panels.label: Together
panels.title: Take one, or take both.
panels.text: Work with us on capital, on consulting, or on both at once. You choose what the business needs right now.

paths.title: Which sounds most like you?
paths.tablistLabel: Choose the situation that fits your company

options.label: We are ready to grow
options.headline: You need capital to take the next step.
options.text: Tell us what the money is for and where you want the business to be. We look at the plan, the numbers and the team, then talk openly about whether and how we can invest.
points: A close look at the plan and the numbers

options.label: A shareholder wants to sell
options.headline: Someone wants to cash out, and the business needs to keep going.
options.text: Founders retire, partners move on, early backers want a return. We can provide liquidity for some or all of those shares, so ownership can change while the company stays focused.

options.label: We need a sharper plan
options.headline: The business has outgrown how it is run.
options.text: Growth brings new problems: unclear priorities, stretched leaders, decisions that keep getting pushed. We work with owners and leadership teams on the strategy and the structure to carry it out.
points: An outside view on key decisions

steps.title: Introduction
steps.text: A short call to understand your business, where it is now and what you are looking for.

steps.title: Understanding
steps.text: We dig into the plan, the numbers and the people, and ask the questions an outside partner should.

steps.title: Proposal
steps.text: If there is a fit, we put forward a clear structure for capital, consulting or both.

steps.title: Partnership
steps.text: We get to work alongside you, focused on the goals we agreed on together.

audience.title: For companies at the stage where every decision counts.

items.title: Startups
items.text: Young companies with real traction that need capital and experienced input to reach the next stage.

items.title: Small businesses
items.text: Established, owner-led businesses looking to grow, restructure ownership or plan their next chapter.

items.question: Do you only invest, or do you also consult?
items.answer: Both. Brightarc provides growth capital, shareholder liquidity, and leadership and strategy consulting. You can work with us on one of these or combine them.

items.question: What kinds of companies do you work with?
items.answer: Startups and small businesses. The quickest way to know whether we are a fit is a short conversation about your company and your goals.

items.question: What does shareholder liquidity mean?
items.answer: It gives an existing owner, such as a founder, partner or early investor, a way to sell some or all of their shares. It can help with retirements, partner exits or simply taking some risk off the table.

items.question: Do I need a pitch deck to get in touch?
items.answer: No. A short description of the business and what you are looking for is enough to start the conversation.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Call or email Nora directly, or use the form on this page. We will get back to you to arrange a first conversation.

contact.title: Tell us where you are headed.
contact.lead: A short note is enough. Share a little about your company and what you need, and we will take it from there.
